verification: Resolved from the official public BANC v888 Codex annotation snapshot at neuron_annotations/v888/codex_annotations.parquet; every record is classified as DNg02 under manc_121_cell_type.
interpretation: DNg02 is a flight-motor population that regulates wingbeat amplitude and contributes to steering and thrust. The reverse control reuses this population as a reduced/redirected-thrust simulator state; it is not presented as a dedicated backward-flight cell type.
